description: Search specific job titles by name. Each result includes its id (the titleId the benchmark tools accept in the jobTitleIds filter) and its parent job family, so use this to narrow a benchmark query to an exact title (e.g. "Forward Deployed Software Engineer") within a job family. Set excludeFamilyLikeTitles to drop titles that are effectively just the job family. If this returns no matches, fall back to search-all, which searches every entity type and applies a fuzzy fallback. REQUIRED arguments: searchText.

excludeFamilyLikeTitles.description: When true, exclude titles that are effectively the same as their job family.

searchText.description: Job title to search for (e.g. "forward deployed engineer", "iOS engineer").

name: search-job-titles
